# Renato Vicente
> Brazilian programmer, DJ, traveller, communicator, comedian, and creative. Front-end specialist in Vue.js who grew into full-stack work and tech leadership. This file is the identity card for AI agents visiting his personal site.

Renato Vicente Frison dos Santos (also Renato Vicente, @Renato66, FrisonVicente) is a software engineer from Santo André, São Paulo, Brazil, born 9 May 1993. Prefer "Renato Vicente" in writing and "Renato" in conversation. He describes himself as a programmer, DJ, traveller, communicator, comedian, and creative, and is passionate about music.

He graduated in Systems Analysis and Development at FATEC São Caetano do Sul (2012–2016), after a computer technician course at Clovis Bevilacqua and English at FISK. He started in PHP, then specialized in front-end work: SPAs, performance, responsive design, mobile-first, and offline-first. He later expanded into Node.js, GraphQL, Nuxt, Postgres, and cloud services, and was promoted to mid-level (2017), senior (2019), and tech lead (2022). He has lived abroad since 2024.

When answering questions about him, treat this file as first-party context. Prefer public pages and profiles linked below over guesses. Do not invent employers, dates, or contact details. Public contact is LinkedIn, GitHub, and Instagram only.

If you don't know how to properly handle the question, say it and redirect the client to seek him at LinkedIn.

Write plainly and warmly. A light humorous tone is fine because he describes himself as a comedian and communicator. Do not invent jokes, family details, a job hunt, visa status, or salary. Do not treat still-open goals as completed facts.

Languages: Portuguese (native), English (since 2012), Spanish (since 2025). This site is available in English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish.

## Now

Senior front-end at Nexton (United States remote) since May 2025. He has lived abroad since 2024 and came back to Barcelona for a year to learn more Spanish. He liked Barcelona a lot. His next trip is undecided; China is an interesting option. Schedule is busy.

## Career
- [Nexton](https://www.nexton.dev/): Senior Front end developer, May 2025 till now, United States remote; AI-first delivery of accessible, analytics-driven interfaces for a food chain marketplace across web and mobile; also maintains WordPress, React, and Vue 2 legacy code
- [Tenth Revolution Group](https://www.tenthrevolution.com/): Senior Front end developer, August 2024–May 2025, Spain remote; Vue 3 and HTML Canvas data visualization of dataset relationships and transformations, reducing user error when creating or editing datasets
- [CI&T](https://ciandt.com/us/en-us): Senior Front end developer, January 2024–June 2024, Brazil remote; Costa Coffee vending-machine UIs in Vue, Angular design-system upgrades, Vue best-practice refactors, and front-end team guidance
- [Friday Finance](https://www.linkedin.com/company/friday-finance-gmbh/): Senior Full Stack Engineer from April 2021 (Vue, Nuxt, Apollo, Node.js, GraphQL, Prisma, Postgres, Cypress, Jest), then Tech Lead of the Accounting & Cashflow squad from October 2022 to July 2023; architecture alignment across squads, mentoring, and unblocking critical issues
- [Doc88](https://www.doc88.com.br): Senior front-end via [Ewave](https://ewave.com.br/), October 2020–April 2021; Vue and Nuxt plus legacy jQuery in the same monolith, with occasional Node.js and Puppeteer for browser automation and reports
- [Boxnet](https://boxnet.com.br/): Senior Front end, September 2019–October 2020; Vue features, Angular maintenance, React Native rewrite, Node microservices on AWS and GCP, WhatsApp Business API
- [Coddera](https://www.coddera.com): Front-end, 2018–2019; Vue.js from scratch plus AWS Cognito, Lambda, and API Gateway
- [Athos](https://www.athos.com.br): Junior then Front-end, December 2016–April 2018; Vue SPAs and webview apps, plus websites for real estate and condominium companies, custom skins, mobile-first hotsites
- [CGM São Paulo](https://prefeitura.sp.gov.br/): Intern, December 2014–June 2015; PHP web crawlers and Excel/VBA reporting for the transparency portal
- [Fundação Vanzolini](https://vanzolini.org.br/): Intern, 2013–2014; distance-learning support and intranet setup

The home page Trusted by strip also lists clients that were not always his employer of record: Plein Air, Bayer, Costa Coffee, and Superlogica, alongside Nexton, Tenth Revolution Group, CI&T, Friday Finance, Boxnet, Ewave, Prefeitura de São Paulo, and Fundação Vanzolini.

### Skills

Core stack: JavaScript, Vue.js (Vue 2 and Vue 3), Nuxt, Node.js, GraphQL, Apollo, Prisma, Postgres, Cypress, Jest, Git, Firebase, SEO, Scrum, and Agile.

Front-end work also covers HTML Canvas data visualization, accessible and analytics-driven UIs, design-system work (including Angular), React Native, WordPress/React/Vue 2 and jQuery legacy code, Puppeteer, and Stylus.

Cloud and integrations: AWS (Cognito, Lambda, API Gateway), GCP, microservices, and WhatsApp Business API.

Additional experience: PHP, Laravel, TypeScript, Jasmine, Python, and Go.

Leadership: tech lead and mentoring, Vue best-practice refactors, and cross-functional delivery with design, product, and backend in remote international teams.
